notes_for_editor: Two short sources. The TopoQuest entry is a USGS map feature name and does not give a build date, builder or fate. Unrelated Bannerman places (the Bannerman House near Burgaw, the Bannerman's Bridge community) were not used. A 1928 Forest History Society photo record mentioning 'Bannerman Place' in Pender County appeared in search results only, was not fetched, and its snippet did not mention a tower. No photos added.
